label: Perforated ticket
desc: A ticket silhouette with notched sides and a perforated divider; header, body and stub sections, with a subtle pointer parallax.
use: Release notes, invites, order confirmations, event passes.

label: Postage stamp
desc: A scalloped postage-stamp frame around any content, with an optional postmark overlay.
use: Framing an avatar, badge or image; sent/verified states; landing decoration.

label: Scroll-fade list
desc: A compact scrollable list whose top and bottom edges fade only while more content lies in that direction.
use: Activity feeds, notification panels, dashboard side lists.

label: Option selector with config
desc: A keyboard-navigable grouped listbox with metric bars; the selected item reveals a segmented configuration row.
use: Plan or tier pickers, settings pages, any choice that carries extra options.

label: Animated signature
desc: An SVG signature that draws itself on mount and replays on click or Enter.
use: Footers, about pages, letters, agreement and thank-you screens.

label: Logo trace loader
desc: Traces a mark's outline and resolves into the filled mark; loops or runs once.
use: Page and route loading states, splash screens, empty states.

label: Iridescent foil
desc: A holographic foil frame that shifts with scroll and pointer position around an opaque content surface.
use: Premium plan cards, membership passes, feature callouts on landing pages.

label: Invite code
desc: An invite or token field with a scrambling Regenerate button and a Copy button with confirmation.
use: Team invites, API tokens, share links on dashboard and connect pages.
